name: Trenton–Morrisville Toll Bridge
facts: Trenton–Morrisville Toll Bridge opened December 1, 1952, after two years of construction that cost $6,650,000, and was first crossed by a railroad conductor and a salesman from Bristol, Pennsylvania.
The bridge’s original toll plaza collected fees from both directions, but today tolls are only collected southbound as vehicles enter Pennsylvania from New Jersey.
A $67 million renovation, completed in 2009, added a third northbound lane, a new soundwall on Northbound US 1, and extended deceleration lanes, transforming the bridge’s capacity and safety.
